A Delightful Find
Dec 2023 • Solo
What a gorgeous find!
After reading reviews, I was delighted to stumble upon this bar.
Beautifully decorated for Christmas, it offered a warm welcome.
Once inside, I was surprised by the small size, but the design was such that you didn't feel crowded.
Welcomed by the charming and personable Nguyen, I chose a glass of the Viognier and generous plate of prosciutto.
The experience was delightful.
I will be back to try the Italian white.
Highly recommended.
